name: Protagonist
source:
While being assaulted, he is saved by a mysterious girl. The next day, a transferred student is introduced to the class, which is none other than the mysterious girl named [url=https://vndb.org/c48059]Nagisa[/url]. The protagonist gets closer to her for the thank you and, by the way, they get closer, he learns that in fact they are childhood friends and finally go out together.

Only one day, the protagonist notices that his aggressors no longer annoy him, that Nagisa acts oddly, she looks unhappy as if she were going to cry every time their eyes crossed. He finds that the situation becomes to be strange... 

[spoiler]After a while, the protagonist asks to Nagisa what's going on but she answers that all is well and cut the conversation. Making the connection between his "quiet life" and the behavior of Nagisa, the protagonist goes to a warehouse, where his ex-attackers have given him an appointment. He meets Nagisa who begs him to leave, but it is already too late and Nagisa is gang raped in front of the protagonist who is also raped by [url=https://vndb.org/c48060]Juri[/url].

Nagisa eventually gets pregnant with one of her attackers, probably as a result of her gang rape in the warehouse. After that, they are no longer blackmailed but the protagonist is depressed, no longer has any contact with Nagisa (but they are still in a relationship) because he is shut on himself and he gets knocked on the road by a car. He wakes up a few times later and realizes that he is being raped by a pregnant Nagisa, who keeps saying that she has been waiting for this for a long time. The protagonist resigns himself, and finally accepts his destiny and that all his life is and will forever be a completely chaotic life.[/spoiler]
